conclusion: Heterozygous carrier of the SIRT6 rs117385980 T allele. Two small, underpowered cohort studies independently report this allele depleted among the longest-lived, and they agree on the direction of the effect. Neither reaches statistical significance, neither measured lifespan directly, and the magnitude is not established. A research-grade trend, not an individual prediction.
negatives: In the Iranian cohort the same allele was more frequent among robust (non-frail) participants than among the frail, the opposite direction to its depletion at advanced age. The authors call this a diverse effect and raise antagonistic pleiotropy as one possible explanation; it is unexplained.
